chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from al-Ash'ari, from Samakah ibn Mihran, from Abu Basir, from Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:

Verily, when Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, created Adam (peace be upon him) and placed his offspring in his loins, and wrote for them their provisions and their lifespans, He then sent Gabriel (peace be upon him) to them and said: 'O Adam, verily Allah has written for you provisions and lifespans, so listen and obey.' Adam said: 'O Lord, what are our provisions and our lifespans?' He said: 'As for your provisions, it is food and drink; and as for your lifespans, it is the lifespan.'

key_terms.الْأَقْوَات: Provisions, sustenance, or means of livelihood
key_terms.صُلْب: Loins, referring to lineage or offspring

ai.seo_question: What did Allah decree for Adam regarding his provisions and lifespan?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Baqir (AS) explaining that Allah decreed the specific provisions (rizq) and fixed lifespans for Adam's descendants at the time of his creation. This highlights the divine decree regarding sustenance and duration of life, emphasizing that these are pre-ordained yet subject to divine wisdom and supplication. The narration underscores the balance between predestination and the believer's active engagement through dua and righteous deeds.
